_comment: Size ratchet for .github/ci/metrics (advisory). files: lines of every non-test file over 1000 lines; packages: non-test lines. The PR report warns when a file not listed here passes 1000 lines, or a listed file or package grows past its number here or past its size on main, whichever is smaller (so a shrink tightens the ratchet without an edit here). A PR with a reason to grow something raises its number here, so the reason is in the diff.
